name: Multibagger Ideas
summary: Multibagger Ideas appears in Part 11 of The Buildout. Part 11: The Backlog Is Not the Quarter. Argued in Part 11 (Shipping is not earning), Part 11 (Voices that cross sides).

parts.headline: The Backlog Is Not the Quarter

mentions.section: The margin the book does not show
mentions.excerpt: Multibagger Ideas, on September 28, sets the same exam for December: conversion as guided, gross margin back toward 30%, no second receivable write-off.

sides.claim: Management expects 40% to 50% of backlog to convert to revenue in Q3 alone, roughly $57M to $71M, and the creator views this conversion as making it achievable for the second half to deliver more than $12.7M of net income to common needed to grow…

The creator states the position earns its next tranche if Q3 results in December show backlog converting as guided and gross margin moving back toward 30%, or if Jordan becomes a definitive award; another receivable write-off or gross margin…
Record backlog, 1% growth at CeoTronics; PPIH's Q3 test.
